about: Human overrides for dev-tools/build_word_picture_semantic_bridge.cjs. Put false-positive words under "exclude" (word -> reason) or pinned mappings under "force" (word -> { target, kind: "syn"|"hyp"|"diag" }).

exclude.pitch: homograph (tar vs throw vs musical pitch)
exclude.spring: homograph (season vs coil vs water spring)
exclude.trunk: homograph (elephant vs tree vs car trunk)
exclude.cog: mechanical gear tooth, not human tooth
exclude.castor: caster wheel / oil, not beaver hat
